age_limit.details: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

qualification.details: Candidates whose "contract ID" has already been created under the Apprenticeship Act 1961, during apprenticeship training in any other organisation, are not eligible to apply for this recruitment. | Reservation of seats for each trade will follow state government guidelines for educational institutions, as below: | Candidates applying under any of the above reserved categories must possess a valid, updated certificate complying with existing guidelines. PWD candidates should be in a position to perform routine, basic functioning independently.

salary_details.details: Selected Trade Apprentices will receive a lumpsum stipend of Rs 9,600 to Rs 10,560 per month. Apprentices are expected to arrange their own accommodation and other related arrangements. Medical facilities will be provided by the company as per the provisions of the Workmen Compensation Act, as mentioned in the Apprenticeship Act.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected on the basis of the marks obtained during their ITI
within their specified category and trade. In case of a tie in aggregate marks between applicants
the older candidate will be preferred.
how_to_apply: Only candidates applying through the NAPS portal will be considered for these vacancies. Follow these steps to apply online:
Register as a student on the NAPS portal (if not already registered).
Log in to the NAPS portal home page as a candidate.
Go to "Apprentice Opportunity" and click "Find Establishment".
Select SAIL-IISCO STEEL PLANT, Burnpur (Establishment code: E03171900012).
Apply for the passed-out ITI trade against the vacancies shown on the portal.
Candidates are advised to apply for only one trade that best matches their ITI qualification, and to submit their application well in advance of the closing date.
important_instructions: The apprenticeship training will run for one year from the date of contract creation, and the contract will terminate automatically on completion of the training period. This apprenticeship does not create any right to claim regular employment at SAIL-ISP. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a notarized undertaking confirming they will not demand employment based on the training or its completion.

Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of certificates and testimonials. If a candidate is found, at any stage, to not fulfil the eligibility norms, or to have furnished incorrect/false information or documents, or to have suppressed any document or fact, the candidature will stand cancelled.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to submit their online application well in advance and not wait for the last date, as per the official instructions.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 200 Trade Apprentice posts are available across nine ITI trades at SAIL-ISP, Burnpur: In addition to these 200 seats, SAIL-ISP will maintain a separate waiting list equal to 10% of the total seats, in order of merit. Waiting-list candidates will be called only if there is a shortfall in joining.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates whose "contract ID" has already been created under the Apprenticeship Act 1961, during apprenticeship training in any other organisation, are not eligible to apply for this recruitment. Reservation of seats for each trade will follow state government guidelines for educational institutions, as below: Candidates applying under any of the above reserved categories must possess a valid, updated certificate complying with existing guidelines. PWD candidates should be in a position to perform routine, basic functioning independently.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Stipend / Salary
content_sections.text: Selected Trade Apprentices will receive a lumpsum stipend of Rs 9,600 to Rs 10,560 per month. Apprentices are expected to arrange their own accommodation and other related arrangements. Medical facilities will be provided by the company as per the provisions of the Workmen Compensation Act, as mentioned in the Apprenticeship Act.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected on the basis of the marks obtained during their ITI, within their specified category and trade. In case of a tie in aggregate marks between applicants, the older candidate will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only candidates applying through the NAPS portal will be considered for these vacancies. Follow these steps to apply online: Register as a student on the NAPS portal (if not already registered). Log in to the NAPS portal home page as a candidate. Go to "Apprentice Opportunity" and click "Find Establishment". Select SAIL-IISCO STEEL PLANT, Burnpur (Establishment code: E03171900012). Apply for the passed-out ITI trade against the vacancies shown on the portal. Candidates are advised to apply for only one trade that best matches their ITI qualification, and to submit their application well in advance of the closing date.

content_sections.heading: SAIL ISP Trade Apprentice Duration of Training and General Instructions
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training will run for one year from the date of contract creation, and the contract will terminate automatically on completion of the training period. This apprenticeship does not create any right to claim regular employment at SAIL-ISP. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a notarized undertaking confirming they will not demand employment based on the training or its completion. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of certificates and testimonials. If a candidate is found, at any stage, to not fulfil the eligibility norms, or to have furnished incorrect/false information or documents, or to have suppressed any document or fact, the candidature will stand cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by SAIL IISCO Steel Plant Burnpur for engaging trade apprentices under the Apprenticeship Act 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SAIL IISCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 200 Trade Apprentice vacancies available across various trades such as Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, and more.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date for online applications?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 28 September 2026 for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The final date to submit online applications for the SAIL IISCO Trade Apprentice recruitment is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the specified trades to be eligible for applying to these apprenticeship positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for SAIL IISCO Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years of age as on 28 September 2026 to apply for the posts.

faq.question: Q7. How much stipend is offered to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a lumpsum stipend ranging between Rs 9,600 and Rs 10,560 per month during the training period.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the marks obtained during the ITI course in the specified category and trade, with age preference given in case of a tie.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification for the SAIL IISCO Trade Apprentice recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to register on the NAPS portal, find the establishment SAIL-IISCO STEEL PLANT Burnpur, and apply online through the portal.
